Definition: apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble:--meek. See also G4235.
BiblicalUsage: Praus is the meek one, gentle and humble, and it belongs to the King himself. Jesus says blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth, and Zechariah's prophecy is fulfilled when he rides into Jerusalem meek and sitting upon an ass. Peter says the ornament of a meek and quiet spirit is in the sight of God of great price.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe meekness is strength under control, not weakness, and Christ is the proof: the meek King inherits the earth. I want that spirit, because the world calls it weakness and God calls it precious.
